events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw three TD passes, Tyler Lockett had 130 yards receiving and a score, and the Seattle Seahawks won the NFC West with a 24-3 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks take NFC West title with 24-3 win over Rams

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.description: Matt Moore's first game as Ryan Tannehill's replacement was the best of his career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moore sets career high with 4 TDs as Miami routs Jets

headlines.description: The bumbling Cleveland Browns are two losses short from becoming the NFL's second team to go 0-16 in one season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns drop to 0-14 following  33-13 loss to Bills

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers hit Jordy Nelson with a 60-yard pass to set up Mason Crosby's 32-yard field goal as time expired to lift the Packers to a 30-27 victory over the Bears in one of their coldest games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers beat Bears 30-27 after Rodgers' big pass to Nelson

headlines.description: Chris Boswell tied the club record with six field goals, and Ben Roethlisberger threw a touchdown pass in the fourth quarter Sunday, rallying Pittsburgh to a 24-20 victory over the Cincinnati Ben
headlines.shortLinkText: Boswell's 6 field goals lead Steelers over Bengals 24-20

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Ryan Succop kicked a 53-yard field goal into the wind as time expired Sunday to give the Tennessee Titans a 19-17 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs on a frigid afternoon at Arrowhead Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Succop's 53-yard field goal gives Titans 19-17 win over KC

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for 250 yards and two touchdowns and the Indianapolis Colts rolled to a 34-6 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Colts handle Vikings defense in 34-6 victory

events.name: Detroit Lions at New York Giants

headlines.description: Odell Beckham Jr. made another one-hand touchdown catch to delight replay fanatics, the defense turned in another stifling performance and the New York Giants inched closer to a playoff berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning's 2 TDs, Beckham one-hander lead Giants past Lions

headlines.description: The Ravens survived a desperate comeback bid by the Eagles, stopping a 2-point conversion with 4 seconds left in a 27-26 victory Sunday that kept Baltimore in the thick of the playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens hold on at end to squeeze past Eagles 27-26

headlines.description: Tom Savage threw for 260 yards after Brock Osweiler was benched, and Lamar Miller scored Houston's only TD with less than three minutes remaining as the Texans rallied for a 21-20 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Osweiler benched for Savage as Texans beat Jags 21-20

headlines.description: Devonta Freeman ran for three touchdowns, Matt Ryan passed for two more and the Atlanta Falcons clinched their first winning season since 2012 with a 41-13 rout of the hapless San Francisco 49ers
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman's 3 TDs lead Falcons to 41-13 rout of hapless 49ers

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: Drew Brees snapped out of a two-game funk to throw for 389 yards and four touchdowns, leading the New Orleans Saints past the Arizona Cardinals 48-41 Sunday in the season's highest-scoring game.

events.name: New England Patriots at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Tom Brady overcame a slow start to lead the New England Patriots to a rare win in Denver on Sunday, a 16-3 grinder that dealt a crushing blow to the Broncos' playoff hopes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady leads Patriots to 16-3 win over Broncos

events.name: Oakland Raiders at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Sebastian Janikowski kicked a 44-yard field goal with 2:40 left, his fourth of the game, and the Oakland Raiders beat the San Diego Chargers 19-16 Sunday to clinch their first playoffs since 2002
headlines.shortLinkText: Janikowski, Raiders beat Bolts 19-16 to earn playoff berth

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott celebrated a short touchdown run by jumping into an oversized Salvation Army red kettle and the Dallas Cowboys closed in on home-field advantage in the playoffs with a 26-20 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red-letter day: Elliott, Cowboys bounce back, top Bucs 26-20

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw an interception and fumbled near his goal line as the Washington Redskins coughed up their easiest path to the playoffs with a 26-15 loss to the defending NFC champion Carolina
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins lose control of playoff hopes with loss to Panthers
